title: error alerts alarms
body:
Screenshots with the problem and time with the accompanying screenshot recording the date and time I send as attachments attached to this message.

The problem is alarms, see screenshot. I also noticed that the app at the top often reports that a basal profile has been updated. But I don't change the basal profile in any way. I use a local profile.

Circumstances when this happens are often when I have the phone in my hand, or. shortly after its postponement. But if I don't notice the phone, I rarely notice the problem.

I supply a screenshot of the assembly and logs as well.

Thanks very much for support.
